instructions: Greenfield Swift/SwiftUI project. Do NOT suggest backward-compatibility shims, legacy fallbacks, or deprecation paths — update all call sites in the same change. Skip style/formatting nits (handled by swift-format). Focus on correctness, security, and maintainability.

rules.rule: Reusable business logic belongs in *Core targets; executable parsing and terminal output belong in *CLI targets. Flag misplaced logic.
Prefer explicit error handling (do/try/catch, guard let, if let) over force unwraps (!) or force tries (try!). Flag new force unwraps outside tests.
Avoid inline array literals that mix multiple sorted-dictionary .map{...}.joined() chains. Pre-bind each chain to a typed [String] to prevent Swift 6.2 type-checker timeouts.
Configuration display must redact keys, tokens, and secrets.
Project is greenfield and unreleased. Reject suggestions to add backward-compatibility shims, legacy code paths, or deprecation warnings.
